subtitle: reusable 3rd-person shooter systems (shooter3) + an Antichamber-style horror world (veilfire) built on them
note: Shader-raymarch build on the existing world3/anim3 kit. Read swarm/SPEC.md FIRST — it is the one truth (whiteboard layout, population layout, file ownership, constraints, the eye). Claim a node before editing; edit ONLY your files; a node is green ONLY when render_probe confirms it. Camera is driven from whiteboard uni4(60/61). Authored by Claude (Fable); Opus builds.

nodes.area: the one truth: whiteboard index map, population layout (2 entries/entity, kind codes), file ownership, hard constraints, the eye recipe
nodes.technique: doc-as-contract; every node imports these numbers verbatim
nodes.spec: Own swarm/SPEC.md. Lock the whiteboard rows and the population layout. CRITICAL open item: reconcile the 2-entry/entity 3D population layout with anim3-lib's ACTUAL per-entity input contract — read scenes/anim3-lib.wgsl, decide the mapping, and write it into SPEC.md as law before enemies/projectiles build. Nothing downstream may diverge.
tests: SPEC.md resolves the anim3 population-mapping question with a concrete decision

evidence.contract-locked: anim3-lib is stateless (verified L8-15); 2-entry layout drives it by extraction; whiteboard + population layout locked as LAW in SPEC.md

nodes.area: the per-node eye: build a node's minimal test world-state and render_probe it (static + scripted-WASD clip)
nodes.technique: wrap tools/render-probe.mjs (deno, --unstable-webgpu) + render-service render-core; assert errors:[], coverage, motion, dominantColors
nodes.spec: Own swarm/probe.mjs. Given a cartridge state JSON (or a node's assembled fragments) render N ticks with an input clip and print a pass/fail on: no compile errors, non-empty coverage, expected motion (comX/comY travel), and expected colors. Provide a scripted WASD+fire clip helper. This is how every other node proves green.
tests: probe returns a clean verdict on a known-good state (e.g. a bare world3 room)

evidence.probe-works: swarm/probe.mjs wraps deno render-probe; returned clean verdict on world3-base (coverage 59%, motion true)

nodes.area: a fullscreen raymarch field that renders a test w3_map room with the world3 camera driven from the whiteboard
nodes.technique: screen-shape field; visual calls mod_w3_ray/march/nrm/light/fog; camera from uni4(60/61)
nodes.spec: Adopt scenes/world3-lib.wgsl as a module. Author a minimal visual_s3 that marches a placeholder w3_map (a floor + a box room) and lights it. Confirm the camera reads uni4(60)=ro.xyz,fov and uni4(61)=target — a hook that orbits the camera makes it move. This is the render spine renderer-mega extends. Keep march ≤96 steps, shadows ≤24.
tests: probe static: a lit 3D room renders, errors:[]
probe orbit clip: camera moves (comX travel > 0)

evidence.render-verified: lit 3D room + pillar renders (coverage 59%, warm headlamp); w3-static.png
evidence.camera-verified: orbit hook drives uni4(60/61); motion true, avgFrameDelta 4.7

nodes.area: WASD free-walk in 3D + collision against w3_map + a 3rd-person follow camera
nodes.technique: hook reads wd.input.moveX/moveY, integrates player pos, samples w3_map (mirrored in JS or via a coarse height/wall probe) for collision, writes camera rows behind+above the player
nodes.spec: Own shooter3/hooks/movement.mjs exporting function(sim,dt,G). Move playerX/Y/Z (rows 1-3) by moveX/moveY relative to playerYaw (row 4; mouse or A/D turns). Collide against walls — mirror the room's collision SDF in JS (one truth, two callers) OR keep a coarse walkable mask. Write uni4(60)=camera behind+above player, uni4(61)=player. Free-walk, no falling through floors.
tests: probe WASD-forward clip: playerZ/comves change, no wall tunneling
camera stays behind player

evidence.moves-verified: unit: hold-W walks -6→5.0 down the nave, A turns yaw; probe: camera walks (motion true, avgFrameDelta 5.5)
evidence.collision-verified: wall-slide AABB mirror of rooms extents; clamps before far wall (≤8.6), no tunneling

nodes.area: the one megashader: raymarch the world AND draw every population entity (enemies, projectiles, death bits) in a single dispatch, plus muzzle/hit flashes
nodes.technique: extend visual_s3: after the world march, loop pop(i) by kind and composite billboarded/marched entities; read flash timers from whiteboard
nodes.spec: Own shooter3/render.wgsl (grows world3-base's visual_s3). Loop for i in 0..popCount()/2; branch on kind (SPEC population layout): draw walker/flyer enemies (via anim3/skel or a marched SDF), projectiles (glowing tracers), death bits (ember). Respect the ≤16-dispatch law — ALL entities in THIS one visual. Add muzzle flash (row 15), hit flash (row 16) as additive HDR. Stay within march + 300KB budget.
tests: probe with a seeded population of each kind: all render, errors:[]
__budget.frameMs within budget at 50 entities

nodes.area: animated baddies: population enemies posed by anim3, spawned into rooms, with seek + attack AI
nodes.technique: hook maintains enemy list, writes 2 pop entries/enemy (pos+kind, hp+animPhase+yaw); anim3 poses them; AI seeks player, telegraphs + attacks in range
nodes.spec: Own shooter3/hooks/enemies.mjs + shooter3/enemies.wgsl. Spawn walkers/flyers; each frame update pos toward player (row 1-3), set animPhase for gait/attack, yaw to face player. Attack: when in range, wind-up then strike (set a flag combat reads). Draw helpers in enemies.wgsl used by renderer-mega. Reconcile with the contracts node's anim3 mapping.
tests: probe: enemies render animated, move toward player across ticks
attack telegraph visible in range

evidence.render-verified: composite probe: demons render as gaunt ember walkers (gait), one closing to melee by the doorway; /tmp/en.png
evidence.ai-verified: unit: demon0 seeks player 11.07→2.07 over the run, 3 in-range strikes → __vf.hits for combat; faces player via yaw

nodes.area: player + enemy projectiles as population entities: fire, travel, expire
nodes.technique: hook spawns a proj (kind 3/4) on fire (pointer.pressed / action), integrates straight-line travel, expires by lifespan/hit; renderer draws glowing tracers
nodes.spec: Own shooter3/hooks/projectiles.mjs. Player fires from camera/player forward on wd.input.pointer.pressed (respect reload row 19, ammo row 7, set muzzleFlash row 15). Enemy projectiles from flyers. Travel in 3D, expire off-range. Hand positions to combat for hit-tests. Cap total, reuse dead slots.
tests: probe fire clip: tracer spawns on click and travels forward
muzzle flash pulses

evidence.fire-verified: unit: fires on click (1), not on space (0)

nodes.area: hit detection + health + damage + score: projectile↔enemy and enemy-attack↔player
nodes.technique: hook does distance hit-tests each frame (proj vs enemy pos, enemy-attack vs player), applies damage, decrements HP, awards score, flags deaths
nodes.spec: Own shooter3/hooks/combat.mjs. On proj-enemy overlap: kill/damage enemy (hp row in pop entry 2), spawn death event for death-fx, +score (row 8), set hitFlash. On enemy strike in range: playerHP (row 6) down, shake (row 17). gameState (row 14) → dead at HP 0. Pure sim; no rendering.
tests: scripted clip: fire at an enemy → enemy hp drops → death event
enemy in range → playerHP drops

nodes.area: explosion deaths + hit sparks + screen shake — reuse the pixelburst ember burst
nodes.technique: on a death event, spawn short-lived death-bit population (kind 5) that arcs+fades ember; camera shake from row 17; additive HDR for bloom to catch
nodes.spec: Own shooter3/hooks/deathfx.mjs + shooter3/deathfx.wgsl. Port the PIXELBURST reversible-arc/ember-morph (scenes/pixelburst-cartridge.mjs) into 3D death bits: on kill, emit N bits at the enemy, arc + cool to ember, expire. Hit sparks smaller. Feed shakeAmt (row 17) that the camera hook reads. Rely on postProcess bloom.
tests: probe: a death event produces an ember burst that fades
shake visible on player hit

nodes.area: health / ammo / score / crosshair / dread meter drawn in-shader
nodes.technique: char5x7 + printInt in a screen-space overlay pass of the megashader, fed from whiteboard rows
nodes.spec: Own shooter3/hud.wgsl (a function renderer-mega calls after the world). Health bar (row 6), ammo (row 7), score (row 8) via printInt, a center crosshair, a dread meter (row 12). Screen-space (use raw pixel uv, not the 3D march). Legible over dark scenes.
tests: probe: HUD elements render and reflect whiteboard values

nodes.area: fire / hit / death / footstep sfx + a music bed + a dread stinger
nodes.technique: hook sets worldData.__play_sound on events and __play_music for the bed; dread stinger on tension spikes
nodes.spec: Own shooter3/hooks/audio.mjs. Trigger sfx on fire (projectiles), hit/death (combat/death-fx), footstep cadence (movement). Music bed on boot; swell/stinger as dread (row 12) rises. Keep it event-driven off the shared __vf state; no double-fires (edge-guard).
tests: scripted clip: fire/hit/death set __play_sound (assert in hook output, audio is not in the probe frame)

nodes.area: VEILFIRE's multi-room Gothic interior as one w3_map: nave, cloister, crypt, spiral — via domain repeat/polar + region gates and doorways
nodes.technique: w3_map composes grown architecture (grow_building) + mod_w3_lancet/arch/bezStrut/taperStrut; rooms tiled by mod_w3_repeat/polar; region ids set material/roomId
nodes.spec: Own veilfire/rooms.wgsl exporting w3_map(p)->vec2f used by renderer-mega. Author a walkable multi-room layout (bigger than a single box): connected chambers with doorways, verticality, a spiral. Return material ids per room for lightdark/atmosphere. Provide a JS collision mirror (or a coarse walkable test) for movement. Keep SDF eval cheap (this runs every march step).
tests: probe walk clip through a doorway: rooms render, you can pass between them
no wall tunneling (the VEILFIRE clip bug)

nodes.area: the light/dark mechanic: a carried lantern lights a radius; dark zones hide the way and empower demons; projective god-rays from windows
nodes.technique: lightLevel per point from carried light (rows 10-11 lantern) + window shafts (sanctum mod_beams projective technique); AI + visibility read lightLevel (row 9)
nodes.spec: Own veilfire/lightdark.wgsl. Compute per-fragment light from the carried lantern (falloff around player) + fixed sconces + projective window shafts (borrow sanctum's mod_beams). Write a room lightLevel the hook/AI read (row 9). Dark = near-black with only ember/eyes; light = reveals architecture and repels/staggers demons. Lantern fuel (row 11) drains; darkness raises dread (row 12).
tests: probe: lantern lights a radius, dark elsewhere
moving into a shaft brightens; fuel drains over the clip

nodes.area: the horror enemies: grown demon rigs with attacks, light/dark-aware (bolder in dark, staggered by light)
nodes.technique: growDemonRig rigs posed via anim3 as enemy population; AI reads lightLevel to modulate aggression; attack telegraphs tuned for dread
nodes.spec: Own veilfire/demons.wgsl. Specialize the shooter3 enemies for horror: growDemonRig visuals (ember-crack crust, facing player), slow menacing approach in light, fast lunges in dark, a wind-up attack. Reuse enemies' population + AI scaffolding; add the light/dark modulation (reads vf-lightdark's lightLevel). Distinct silhouettes readable at the edge of the lantern light.
tests: probe: a demon emerges from dark, lunges; light staggers it
reads as horror, not generic

evidence.render-verified: horror pass: ribs/sockets/maw catch ember, close-up /tmp/demon2.png

nodes.area: the dread layer: volumetric fog, torchlight + soft shadow + AO + vignette (monistary recipe), drifting embers (KINDLE), audio dread
nodes.technique: mod_w3_fog + monistary torch/shadow/AO palette + a light ember population drift + postProcess vignette/bloom tuned dark
nodes.spec: Own veilfire/atmosphere.wgsl. Layer fog depth, torch flicker, heavy AO, strong vignette; drifting ember motes (a small population or procedural). Tune postProcess (low exposure, high vignette, gentle bloom on embers/eyes). Coordinate the audio dread bed with the audio node. This is the mood pass over the whole scene.
tests: probe: scene reads dark, foggy, torch-lit with vignette; embers drift over the clip

evidence.render-verified: down-nave probe: cold blue haze veils depth (KINDLE), /tmp/fog.png

nodes.area: assemble shooter3 + veilfire into one cartridge, wire the room progression/objectives, deploy and full playtest
nodes.technique: compose modules (world3, anim3, shooter3/*, veilfire/*) + the one visual + the ordered composite step hook; deploy via bridge; probe the whole loop
nodes.spec: Own web/src/app/engine/scenes/veilfire-cartridge.mjs. Import every fragment, register modules + visual_s3 + the composite hook (order per SPEC), create the fields (one screen render field + any population/hud), set postProcess, deploy. Add room-to-room progression + a win/lose objective. Full playtest via a scripted WASD+fire+move-through-rooms clip; ship only when the eye shows a real playable loop.
tests: full-loop probe: walk rooms, fire, kill a demon (ember death), take damage, light/dark works, HUD live
__budget.frameMs within budget
